name: hcportal_logClientError
description: Records a client-side error from the Flutter admin portal into HC.ErrorLog — the portal's equivalent of publicWeb_logWebError. Auth is attempted, not required: an unauthenticated report is accepted only from a device that exists in HC.Device. Added 2026-09-23; before it the portal had no client error telemetry at all.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth (optional). With accessToken, resolves userId. Without a valid token, must still name an existing device.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth (optional). Generated for 'hcportal_logClientError' with the device secret as paramString.

parameters.name: errorName
parameters.description: One line: the exception's message or type. Truncated to 250.

parameters.name: errorDescription
parameters.description: The stack, first frames. Truncated to 2500.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Which handler caught it: portal-flutter (FlutterError.onError) or portal-async (PlatformDispatcher.onError). Default portal-client.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: The page the user was on, where known.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success 1, or Success 0 with ErrorMessage ('errorName is required', 'Unknown device', or the CATCH message).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
